# Navya EdTech

> Navya EdTech is an IT services agency in Nepal engineering revenue-driving websites, custom software, and business systems (ERP, CRM, BI) for founders, schools, hospitals, and enterprises.

Remote-first, serving clients across Nepal. Contact: navyaedtech26@gmail.com.

## Services

- [Website Development](https://navyaedtech.com/services/websites): Built to convert.
- [Custom Software Development](https://navyaedtech.com/services/custom-software-development): Built around your workflow.
- [Mobile App Development](https://navyaedtech.com/services/mobile-app-development): A permanent place on their screen.
- [AI Solutions](https://navyaedtech.com/services/ai-solutions): Automation with a measurable return.
- [Cloud Services](https://navyaedtech.com/services/cloud-services): Infrastructure that scales without drama.
- [UI/UX Design](https://navyaedtech.com/services/ui-ux-design): Interfaces built to convert.
- [DevOps](https://navyaedtech.com/services/devops): Deployments without the dread.
- [IT Consulting](https://navyaedtech.com/services/it-consulting): A technology plan tied to business outcomes.
- [Dedicated Developers](https://navyaedtech.com/services/dedicated-developers): Senior engineers, without the hiring cycle.
